name: av_showcase
description: Spatial Intelligence Virtual Tour Platform & Point Cloud Walkthrough Engine

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:coords
scripts.build:python: cd backend && python -m PyInstaller --onefile --collect-all numpy app.py --distpath ./dist
scripts.build:electron: cmd /c "if exist release-final rmdir /s /q release-final" && npx @electron/packager . AV_Showcase --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release-final/ --asar=false --overwrite
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:python && npm run build:electron
